text:
olivia: @here Harbor-3 (model_id=harbor-3) is GA on Hosted API. Streaming v3 + tool-calling v3 are live. Docs & migration: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/harbor-3 :tada:

olivia: New for this GA: feature-flagged per-tenant early access, expanded telemetry events (token_churn, kv_cache_hits), and a customer-facing GA banner that will go up in 30m.

 tom: Can we get the exact event names for telemetry so mobile teams can wire dashboards?

docs: Added events: `redwood.harbormodel.request_start`, `redwood.harbormodel.stream_chunk`, `redwood.harbormodel.tool_call`, `redwood.harbormodel.kv_cache_hit`. We'll publish the schema in the telemetry docs section.

infra-bot: deploy: harbor-3-stream-v3 canary rolled to us-east-1 at 1816123468. Monitoring token churn and latency.

olivia: Breaking migration note: `tool_input` -> `tool_args`. Also tool return values must be valid JSON objects now; if invalid we fallback to text. Strict mode available via `?validation=strict`. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/tools-v2-to-v3

kevin: For Dedicated customers who need a freeze window, how do they pin?

olivia: Dedicated & Private: Console -> Settings -> Models -> Pin, or API header `x-redwood-model: harbor-2@<version>`. Pinning preserves runtime variant and quantization profile.

docs: Limits to add to docs: default streaming concurrency = 200 streams/org, default max tokens per stream = 65k. Support can request increases for enterprise customers.

support-sre: KB created: "Harbor-3 GA: checklist & common fixes". Escalation tag #harbor-3-ga added to on-call playbook. Also adding a canned reply for Zendesk.

olivia: Rollout plan: 0-10% canary (30m), 10-50% regional (3h), 50-100% global (24h) with rollback gates on error rate >1% or latency p95 >2x baseline. Internal rollout dashboard: Console -> Deployments -> Harbor-3.

tom: SDK note: streaming SDK v1 deprecated, 90 day migration window. We should add a snippet for buffered versus chunked consumers.

docs: Uploaded streaming v3 examples for Node/Python/Go including chunked consumer patterns.

infra-bot: No anomalies in first 10m. GPU utilization normal.

kevin: Will customers see any change in billing for streaming tokens or tool-calls?

olivia: No pricing changes with this GA. We'll announce any future pricing updates separately.

olivia: Thanks team. Post-GA sync at 16:00 PT to review telemetry and open any follow-ups. Ping me for urgent issues. :rocket:
